title: Notification pop-ups appear partially off-screen with tiny right-edge-aligned panel that's narrower than the Notification popups
line: Notification popups now stay fully on screen when the panel holding the notifications widget is short and aligned to the screen edge.
explanation: With popups placed near the widget, the area used to place them was narrowed to the width of the horizontal panel holding the widget. The same area was used both to align popups and to keep them on screen, so a popup wider than a short panel was centered on the panel and, with the panel at the screen's right edge, ran past the edge. The change keeps a separate alignment area for the panel and clamps the popup to the whole available screen area.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: Keep popups on screen next to a short panel

Popups near the widget were placed in an area cut down to the panel, so
a popup wider than a short right-aligned panel went past the screen
edge. Keep aligning popups to the panel, but clamp them to the screen.

BUG: 473027
